requirement: R10 partial (render policy + surrounding states); the ECharts mount lifecycle is explicitly out until the owner decides

files.role-model-router/packages/ui/src/foldki: extended with ChartState, bounded reasons, distinct loading/error/stale/truncated/empty/ready rendering and the deterministic render policy
files.role-model-router/packages/foldkit/test/: existing Scene suite extended (3 original + 7 state/policy tests = 10)

policy.statement: view(config, h) is a pure function of (series, state). No clock read, no Math.random/crypto.randomUUID, no ids, no config mutation. Staleness is displayed only from caller-supplied ageMs/ruleMs; truncation only from caller-supplied droppedPoints. The same config produces the same VNode tree twice (test serializes two renders and compares).
policy.stateModel: config.state?: ChartState = ready | loading | empty | error{reason} | stale{ageMs,ruleMs} | truncated{droppedPoints}; default ready. A ready render with no usable series is normalized to the explicit empty state.

statuses.loading: figure[data-chart-status=loading] + role=status aria-live=polite aria-busy=true text 'Loading chart data…'; no svg/table
statuses.error: figure[data-chart-status=error] + role=alert text 'Chart unavailable: <bounded single-line reason>'; no svg/table; boundedChartReason caps at 160 chars and replaces control chars/whitespace
statuses.empty: figure[data-chart-status=empty] + role=status [data-chart-empty] 'No chart data available.'; no svg/table; distinct from loading
statuses.stale: figure[data-chart-status=stale] + chart stays + visible [data-chart-notice=stale] 'Stale: data is <age> old (rule <rule>).'; age/rule formatted purely from caller inputs
statuses.truncated: figure[data-chart-status=truncated] + chart and table stay + visible [data-chart-notice=truncated] 'Truncated: showing N of N+M points (M dropped).'; table caption repeats the shown/total/dropped numbers, so points are never silently lost

green.command: cd role-model-router/packages/foldkit && vitest run test/s13b-foldkit-chart.test.ts --environment happy-dom
cases: error: role=alert, bounded single-line reason (helper directly checked for no newline and <=160), no svg/table
stale: chart stays, notice carries 12s and 5m from caller inputs
truncated: chart/table stay, notice carries '2 of 5' and '3 dropped'
empty: explicit empty status, no svg/table, not loading
determinism: all seven state configs render identical JSON twice, no id attribute and no clock/random calls

truncationVisibility: The truncated test asserts the chart still exists, the table still exists, and the visible notice contains the dropped count (3) and the shown-of-total (2 of 5). Removing the notice makes that test fail (s13c-red-truncated.log), so a silent drop cannot pass.

determinismGrep.result: no code matches for Date.now/performance.now/Math.random/randomUUID/h.Id/h.Key (the only source matches are the policy comment).

r10StillNeeds: The owner's decision on the ECharts dependency and then the mount lifecycle: Mount/acquireRelease lazy import, resize/theme observers and cleanup, tooltip/legend interaction, live range/filter updates with obsolete-work suppression, stable variant on theme updates, multi-instance collision-free host ids (this primitive deliberately has no ids), hidden/zero-size container resize, repeated mount/unmount heap bounds, font readiness, canvas animation completion at fixed DPR/timezone, bounded diagnostic timeout, browser fixtures and bounded captures. No claim is made that the SVG helper module's dependency closure costs zero.
doesNotDo: No ECharts import or dependency, no canvas, no Mount; vendor/crease/src/lib/echarts.ts remains untouched.
No data fetching, automatic staleness computation, or truncation accounting: these are caller inputs (the renderer only displays them), which is what makes the markup deterministic.
No tooltip/legend interaction, no animation/transitions, no live updates, no theme/resize handling.
No ids anywhere, so multi-instance host ids remain an R10 concern rather than an accidental collision here.
scope: Only foldkit-chart.ts, its Scene test and evidence were written. No dependency, vendor, root, lockfile, other package, existing test or private repo change.
